title: Cable Comb Set — What cable combs do

title: Cable Comb Set — Closed vs open combs

title: Cable Comb Set — Common mistakes
description: The classic mistake is forcing a 24-slot comb onto a cable whose wires split into two rows — it needs two 12-slot combs or a proper 24. The other is combing too tight near the connector, which strains the pins.
